author: DarkNull8
quote:
I have been waiting for this game for 13 years and I expected liberty of choice like in past games and we clearly don't have choice in most of the cases like I don't want Lúcia and I can end up things with her but I don't have choice to leave her on the prison and she take the bus like she said, and I can't really start a relationship with any other NPC and I can't contract a Prostitute that are things present on games since GTA III. But not only that u dont have a choice to ditch Donnie on the start for an example and u dont have a choice to sell the cargo you first recover to anyone that's not Donnie and Rockstar even goes to the level of paralising all characters, services and removing all the icons on the map, so if u broke your car trying to get there u can't even fix the car and end up running 2.5KM because of that. 
I'm not complaining about FPS or even variable render resolution because the PS5 is obviously the problem on that matter.... 
My opinion- buy the game and play it, but don't count on the same freedom of past GTA titles its clearly rigged so you stay with lucia and every illegality brings cops on you and u end up preferring to not steal a car and run than run from the cops and hide for like 5min. But if you intend to play the game like it was designed and be a good boy I bet it gonna be fun for you!
